title: QSplit Quantum Connector Wrapper
description: Connector wrapper that filters available locations based on reported availability and queue length.

provider.description: Logical provider name handled by this connector (classic, dwave, ibm, iqm).

availabilityProbability.description: If set to 0, the provider is treated as unavailable. Any positive value keeps the provider enabled.

maxQueueLength.description: If set, locations are filtered out when the queue length exceeds this value.
